**Consolidated into the ledger-convergence card #12159** by maintainer ruling (2026-08-26, verbatim 「同意」, recorded in full on #12359): this consolidation, the #12359 registration move (option B — registration moves to `PlatformObjectsPlugin`, single owner) and the L8 permission-set convergence are one card, one PR, one verification pass — three touches of the same hot surface collapsed into one review. This issue stays open and will be closed by that PR.

One constraint from this card's own analysis that the convergence card carries forward: the shared store must live in a package both `service-automation` and `objectql` may depend on — `@objectstack/core` is the leading candidate; `platform-objects` as the *code* home would invert the tiering for objectql (registration moving there is a composition-level matter, orthogonal to this).
